units.source_text: 从皇上、皇太子、秋好皇后、明石皇后，以至源氏诸夫人，各方都赠送诵经布施及供佛物品。

en.t: From the Emperor, the Crown Prince, Empress Akikonomu, and Empress Akashi, down to all Genji's ladies, every quarter sent offerings for sutra recitations and articles for Buddhist worship.

units.source_text: 只此数项，已经途为之堵塞；何况此时朝中没有一人不热心赞助此法会，故气象盛大无比。

en.t: These few items alone already clogged the roads; moreover, at this time no one at court was anything but eager to support the service, so the spectacle was magnificent beyond compare.

units.source_text: 不知紫夫人是何时准备这种种设计的。

en.t: No one knew when Lady Murasaki had prepared all these arrangements.

units.source_text: 似乎是几世以前许下的宏愿。

en.t: It seemed like a great vow she had made many lifetimes before.

units.source_text: 当日花散里夫人与明石夫人都到场。

en.t: On that day Lady Hanachirusato and Lady Akashi were both present.

units.source_text: 紫夫人打开了南面和东面的门，自己设席其中，这是正殿西面的库房。

en.t: Lady Murasaki opened the doors on the south and east sides and set up her own seat there, in the storeroom west of the main hall.

units.source_text: 诸夫人的席设在北厢，仅用屏风隔开。

en.t: The ladies' seats were arranged in the northern side room, separated only by screens.
